integrity.baselineSelectionSemantics: Phase15/17 validated baseline trades; timestamp remap on refreshed data

methodology.purpose: Descriptive attribution of favorable/adverse path before versus after the baseline exit.
methodology.preExitWindow: Entry candle excluded; exit candle included.
methodology.postExitWindow: 500 bars after exit or dataset end.
methodology.postExitReference: Baseline exit price: TP1 for TP1 exits, stopLoss for SL exits. Continuation is measured from this exit price, independently of entry price.
